contact_contracts.batch: 733810 records limit and both current counts;733880 reduces each appended tail separately. Entity resolver727D60 passes limit4. If new tail count<=limit no change. Otherwise deepest penetration first (ordinary finite ties preserve earlier index), then choose candidates by largest minimum over selected contacts of penetration+Euclidean point distance, initialized/capped by FLT_MAX. Every winner swaps complete1C0-byte records; final end=begin+(oldcount+limit)*1C0.
contact_contracts.batch_fallback: Each later selection initializes candidate index0 and score0, even if tail begins later. This is the exact branch behavior, not a demonstrated reachable gameplay bug; nonfinite first-selection behavior differs across unrolled comparisons.
